references.text: Ekron is mentioned as one of the five Philistine cities that had not yet been conquered
Judah took Ekron along with other Philistine cities after Joshua's death
Ekron was one of the cities to which the ark of the covenant was sent by the Philistines
Ekron is mentioned in connection with the border between Israel and the Philistines
Baal-Zebub, Ekron's god, is mentioned when King Ahaziah sent messengers there
The prophet Amos prophesies judgment against Ekron and the Philistines
The prophet Zephaniah prophesies that Ekron will be uprooted
Zechariah prophesies about Ekron's fate and that it will become like a family in Judah
